title: WS-005 - Handle API limits and common HTTP errors
intent: Summarize the global request limit and recurring HTTP responses returned by the EUSurvey Web-services API.
short_answer: For security reasons, the EUSurvey Web-services API is limited to 5000 calls per user per day. Common errors include 403 for wrong credentials or insufficient privileges, 404 for unknown services or missing parameters, 412 when a prerequisite is not met, and 429 when the request limit is exceeded.
procedure: Log and inspect the HTTP status code for every API call.
For 403, verify credentials and survey privileges.
For 404, verify the endpoint path and required parameters.
For 412, check endpoint-specific preconditions, parameter formats, survey status, and whether the survey is archived.
For 429, reduce polling frequency or batch requests to stay within the daily limit.
important_conditions: Asynchronous polling must be designed carefully to avoid consuming the daily request allowance.
Endpoint-specific 412 meanings are more precise than the generic meaning.
Check Basic Authentication and required survey privilege.
Check that the endpoint exists and the full parameter list is present.
Check survey existence, publication status, archived status, parameter validity, date format, IDs, tokens or aliases.
Reduce request volume; the global limit is 5000 calls per user per day.
